name: Food Processor vs. Blender
instruction: Create 3D models of both a food processor and a blender. The food processor should have a wide base with a bowl on top and a lid with a feed tube. The blender should have a tall, narrow jar with a lid and a base with control buttons.

Shape accuracy: The food processor has a wide base.
The food processor features a bowl on top.
The food processor includes a lid with a feed tube.
The blender has a tall, narrow jar.
The blender's base is designed with control buttons.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The bowl on the food processor is proportionate to the base.
The lid of the food processor fits securely on the bowl.
The blender's jar is proportionate to its base.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The food processor's bowl is positioned correctly on the base.
The lid with the feed tube is properly aligned with the bowl.
The blender's jar is securely placed on the base.
The control buttons are easily accessible on the blender's base.
Object distance and contact: There is no gap between the food processor's bowl and base.
The lid of the food processor fits snugly on the bowl.
The blender's jar is in contact with the base without any gaps.

Instruction execution accuracy: Both the food processor and blender are accurately represented as per the instructions.
All specified features of the food processor and blender are included.
